meaning: Currency, cash, currency notes, or financial payment.
hand_configuration: Dominant thumb rubs repeatedly against the tips of the index and middle fingers in a cash counting / banknote rubbing gesture.
isl_grammar_structure: Quantitative / Transactional noun; used in counter questions (e.g. MONEY HOW-MUCH?).
cultural_linguistic_notes: Standard transactional sign across Indian retail, banks, and post offices.

media.description: Thumb rubbing index and middle fingers in banknote transaction gesture.
